turns.text: Good afternoon, I am an AI assistant booking on behalf of my client. May I ask if a table for two at 17:00 today is available?
Hi, sorry, 17:00 is fully booked. I could do 18:30 for two?
Let me check that with my client and get back to you.
Thank you, 18:30 works for my client. Could you kindly let me know the name of the restaurant, please?
Great, 18:30 for two at The Ivy is confirmed.
Wonderful, thank you ever so much. Just to confirm the booking: a table for two (2 people) at 18:30 (6:30 pm) today, Sunday, 22 November 2026, at The Ivy. We look forward to it. Many thanks again!
